metadata.title: Stocks to Watch: Intel, Netflix, SpaceX, Burberry

content.text:
LIVE
Updated 19 min ago
Stocks to Watch: Intel, Netflix, SpaceX, Burberry
↘️ Intel (INTC), Micron Technology (MU), Marvell Technology (MRVL), Advanced Micro Devices (AMD): Chip stocks slid across the board amid concerns about the sustainability of the AI boom.
↘️Netflix (NFLX): Shares fell more than 11% in early trading after the streaming company reported its weakest revenue growth in years.
↘️ Space Exploration Technologies (SPCX): Shares of Elon Musk’s rocket company dropped nearly 4% following Thursday’s aborted Starship launch.
